svg.title: Inspect streamlines: 1 Tractography, 2 visibility, 3 direction colours, 4 slice slab
svg.desc: Original Neurodesk VNC screenshot with numbered click targets. Screenshot pixels are unchanged.

g.title: Open the Tool menu and choose the named display panel
Select the loaded image; use its checkbox to hide or show it
Keep Direction selected for streamline colours
Keep crop to slab checked with a thickness of 2.5 mm
